name: J. B. Brown, Dearborn Street grocery

partners.name: J. B. Brown
partners.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card brown_jesse_b (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

partners.name: J. B. Tuttle
partners.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card tuttle_j_b (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names Dearborn Street and nothing narrower; the anchor "Messrs. Newberry & Dole's store" names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-07-02, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 2 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read yankee: J. B. Brown (yankee), J. B. Tuttle (yankee). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
